tables.name: Skgurr Naming Method
tables.description: Which naming method a Skgurr settlement name uses. Skgurr always uses Geographic Compound, so no die is rolled: it has no founder, survival or misfortune naming methods.

results.name: Geographic Compound
results.description: First element + second element as one word, e.g. Dunwick, Inverness, Muckleskerry.
